listing.name: Guitar Hero: Warriors of Rock / re-wor
listing.summary: Register an independently permitted, upstream-prepared Guitar Hero: Warriors of Rock / re-wor native Windows player. Keep original data, preparation and runtime replacement upstream.

steps.title: Prepare your own supported original upstream
steps.instruction: Use your own legitimate Xbox 360 Guitar Hero: Warriors of Rock original, retaining assets/default.xex and assets/data, including streams and scripts. Do not substitute another Guitar Hero game. Complete supported extraction upstream; this guide imports no original and runs no helper. Connect the supported XINPUT-compatible guitar or gamepad before launching, as required by this upstream player; no physical-controller qualification is claimed here.

steps.title: Attach the completed native Windows player
steps.instruction: Select Guitar Hero Warriors of Rock.exe, the complete prepared package folder as working directory and no extra arguments for the normal direct native player. Keep only supported literal arguments already needed by your working setup. Do not select re-wor-launcher.exe or a script.

steps.title: Review launch details, then choose Play
steps.instruction: Review the selected game executable, working folder and launch arguments, then agree to use them. Choose Play separately when you are ready. Adding this copy does not prepare, update or replace its external files. Removing its registration leaves all external files in place. Before changing versions, close the game and its companion programs and keep the working copy and all data. Review and select the changed executable before playing again.

steps.title: Keep upstream maintenance outside the attached session
steps.instruction: Upstream and the user retain preparation and runtime replacement. Close the actual game and companions before deliberate replacement; preserve the creating copy and all data and review changed selected bytes before Play.

steps.title: Preserve the creating copy and every effective data root
steps.instruction: Keep the complete creating folder, assets tree and every actual SDK user, save, profile, configuration, mod, cache, log, backup and custom root. The inspected title does not override every SDK persistence default; the working directory alone does not establish complete save coverage. Keep existing effective paths and do not migrate another title or version’s saves.

warnings: Use only a copy and components you are permitted to use. Before changing versions, keep a copy of the complete working game, original files and every profile, save, cache, mod, backup, temporary file and custom data location. Another executable may use the same data. Portcove does not offer updates, backups, rollback, data migration or deletion for these external files.

No root project LICENSE was found in the reviewed source. That absence does not establish permission or a prohibition, and another engine’s licence does not apply automatically. Use only components and original data you are independently permitted to use.
Upstream documents occasional song-transition and audio issues. Portcove has not tested XINPUT instruments or physical controllers.
